quickOpen.title: Quick open

sidebar.title: Collapse the sidebar
sidebar.body: Use the icon next to the app name to shrink the sidebar to an icon column and widen your workspace. It stays that way next time.

panel.title: Side panel
panel.body: Open content next to your workspace (for example "View side by side" in the library). Drag the divider to resize, or go full screen.

keyboard.title: Keyboard
keyboard.body: Ctrl K (⌘K on Apple devices) opens quick open from anywhere. Tab moves through every button and link; with the divider focused, left and right arrows resize the side panel; Esc closes dialogs and panels.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.body: Choose light, dark or system mode and a comfortable text size. Your choice is saved to your account.

install.available: Install to open Learning Companion from your home screen in its own window.
install.installed: The app is installed on this device.
install.manual: This browser hasn't offered installation. On iPhone or iPad: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen". On a computer: use Chrome or Edge and the install icon in the address bar.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Color mode and text size apply right away on this device and are saved to your account.

theme.label: Color mode
theme.lightHint: Light background, good for daytime study.
theme.darkHint: Dark background, easier on the eyes at night.
theme.systemHint: Follows your device's light or dark setting.

font.label: Text size

PASSWORD_CHANGED.body: If this wasn't you, reset your password now.

AI_TASK_REFUNDED.title: No credits charged

AI_TASK_REFUNDED.body_other: {{task}} failed because of an outside service. The {{count}} held credits were fully refunded.

DOCUMENT_READY.title: Your document is ready
DOCUMENT_READY.body: “{{title}}” has been extracted and indexed, ready for questions and study materials.

contentGone.title: This content is no longer available
contentGone.body: It may have been deleted, expired or replaced by a newer version. Your other notifications are still here.

forbidden.title: This page is for administrators only
forbidden.body: Your account has no admin rights. This visit has been recorded in the system audit log.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every sensitive action is recorded automatically: who did what, to which object, when, from which device and with what result. The log holds metadata only, never anyone's learning content.
audit.invalidFilters: The filters aren't valid. Check the date range.
audit.retention: The log is append-only: nobody can edit or delete it, and entries are kept for one year. Every search is recorded too.

empty.title: No entries yet
empty.body: Actions such as sign-ins, password changes and settings changes will be recorded here.
empty.filteredBody: Try removing a condition or widening the date range.

filters.label: Filter the audit log
filters.rangeInvalid: The start date must be on or before the end date.

audit.removed: Content fields removed from the log: {{fields}}

adminLogin.attemptsLeft_one: {{count}} attempt left before admin sign-in is locked for 15 minutes.
adminLogin.attemptsLeft_other: {{count}} attempts left before admin sign-in is locked for 15 minutes.

verify.title: Enter your verification code
verify.body: Open your authenticator app and enter the six-digit code for {{email}}.
verify.codeFormat: The code is exactly six digits.
verify.invalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Enter the code currently shown in the app.

recovery.use: Lost your phone? Use a recovery code
recovery.back: Use a code from the app
recovery.title: Use a recovery code
recovery.body: Enter one of the ten recovery codes you saved during setup. Each code works once, then you must set up your authenticator app again.
recovery.label: Recovery code
recovery.hint: Looks like abcde-fghjk, not case sensitive.
recovery.format: A recovery code has ten letters and digits.
recovery.invalid: That recovery code is wrong or already used.
recovery.used: The recovery code has been used and cannot be used again. Set up the authenticator app on your new phone.

enroll.title: Set up two-step verification
enroll.body: The admin account always needs a code from an authenticator app, so a leaked password alone is never enough.
enroll.resetBody: Your old authenticator app stops working once you finish. You will get ten new recovery codes.
enroll.step1Body: For example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 2FAS, or a password manager that supports TOTP codes.
enroll.step2Title: Add an account with this key
enroll.step2Body: Choose to enter a key manually, name it {{email}}, and pick time-based.
enroll.openApp: Open in an authenticator app on this device
enroll.step3Body: The app shows a six-digit code that changes every 30 seconds. Enter the current code to finish.
enroll.invalid: That code does not match. Check the key you entered and your phone's clock, then enter the current code.

codes.title: Save your ten recovery codes
codes.body: If you lose your authenticator phone, each code below lets you sign in once instead of a six-digit code.
codes.once: These codes are shown only once. Copy or download them and keep them somewhere safe, away from your phone.
codes.copyFailed: The browser blocked copying; select and copy them manually.
codes.fileHeader: Learning Companion admin recovery codes for {{email}}. Each code works once.
codes.confirm: I have saved these codes somewhere safe

locked.title: Admin sign-in is temporarily locked
locked.body: The verification code was wrong 5 times in a row. A warning email was sent to the admin address. You can try again in:

expired.title: Verification step expired
expired.body: For safety, the code step only lasts a few minutes after entering your password. Please sign in again.

aiGateway.title: AI services
aiGateway.subtitle: Every model call goes through one shared gateway: each capability has a primary and a fallback provider, a timeout, retries and a circuit breaker for repeated failures. Each call is metered for units, latency and cost, never its content.
aiGateway.loadFailed: Could not load the gateway configuration.

alerts.title: Circuit breaker alerts
alerts.body: {{provider}} failed repeatedly for {{capability}} and its circuit opened at {{time}}. Calls are going to {{fallback}}.
alerts.bodyNoFallback: {{provider}} failed repeatedly for {{capability}} and its circuit opened at {{time}}. There is no fallback, so learners get a temporary error.

routes.title: Routing by capability
routes.subtitle: Features call a capability, never a provider directly. Changing providers or failing over here needs no feature changes.

providers.title: Providers
providers.subtitle: Only providers confirmed not to train on learning data can be enabled. Secret keys live in the server's secret store; only the key name is declared here.

capabilityHints.TEXT_GENERATION: Streamed answers for the assistant, summaries and questions.
capabilityHints.EMBEDDING: Vectors for semantic search in the library.
capabilityHints.VISION: Describe pictures, diagrams and photos of exercises.
capabilityHints.OCR: Extract text from photos and scanned documents.

route.breakerSummary: {{failures}} failures within {{window}} s, open for {{open}} s
route.switchBody: {{to}} becomes the primary provider and {{from}} becomes the fallback. New calls go to the new provider right away. This is recorded in the audit log.
route.dialogHint: Only enabled providers that are confirmed not to train and support this capability can be chosen.

provider.dialogHint: New providers start disabled. Enable one after its key is in the secret store and the commitment is confirmed.
provider.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; cannot be changed later.
provider.baseUrlOptional: Leave empty to use the default URL.
provider.secretHint: For example LC_AI_OPENAI_KEY. The key value is set on the server, never entered here.
provider.noTrainingLabel: I have checked the contract or terms: the provider commits not to use submitted data to train models.

requirements.SECRET: a key in the secret store
requirements.MODEL: a model name for each capability

errors.generic: That did not work, please try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details are invalid. Check the code, the URL (must start with https://), the key name and the chosen capabilities.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_TRAINING_NOT_CONFIRMED: Cannot enable: the provider has not been confirmed to not train models on learning data. Edit the provider and tick the confirmation after checking its terms.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_SECRET_MISSING: Cannot enable: the server's secret store has no key with the declared name.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_INCOMPLETE: Cannot enable: the service URL or a model name is missing.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_CODE_TAKEN: This code is already used by another provider.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_IN_USE: This provider is a primary in the routing. Change the routing before disabling it or withdrawing the confirmation.
errors.AI_ROUTE_INVALID: Primary and fallback must differ, be enabled and support this capability.
errors.AI_NO_FALLBACK: This capability has no enabled fallback provider.
errors.AI_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: The AI service is temporarily unavailable: retries failed. Try again in a few minutes.

test.title: Test call
test.subtitle: Send a text generation call through the gateway like any feature. It is metered as ADMIN_TEST.
test.defaultPrompt: Explain Ohm's law in one sentence.
test.done: Answered by {{provider}} · {{input}} input units, {{output}} output units.

usage.title: Usage
usage.subtitle: Calls, units and cost by capability and provider.
usage.noContent: Numbers only: the gateway never records prompts or answers.

aiConfig.title: Model and prompt configuration
aiConfig.subtitle: Each AI feature has its own configuration: provider, model, temperature, maximum length and system prompt. Every save creates a new draft version; only the published version serves learners, and rolling back takes one click.
aiConfig.loadFailed: Could not load the configuration. Please try again.

ASSISTANT_CHAT.name: Study assistant
ASSISTANT_CHAT.hint: Answers questions from the learner's documents, with cited sources.

ADMIN_TEST.name: Admin test call
ADMIN_TEST.hint: Used by the test call on the AI services page to check that a provider still answers.

DOCUMENT_OCR.name: Document text recognition
DOCUMENT_OCR.hint: Reads text in scanned pages and photos when uploaded documents are processed.

DOCUMENT_EMBEDDING.name: Document indexing
DOCUMENT_EMBEDDING.hint: Creates semantic vectors for each passage so documents can be searched by meaning.

editor.title: Draft a new version
editor.subtitle: Based on version {{version}}. The running version does not change until you publish.
editor.providerHint: Follow routing to let the gateway pick the primary and fallback provider.
editor.modelHint: Model name on the selected provider. Leave empty to use its default model.
editor.modelNeedsProvider: Choose a provider first to set a model name.
editor.temperatureHint: From 0 to 2. Lower is steadier, higher is more varied.
editor.promptHint: {{count}}/{{max}} characters. Do not include email addresses, phone numbers or details about a specific person.
editor.piiSummary: Found {{count}} passage(s) ({{kinds}}). They are highlighted below; remove them in the editor and save again.
editor.versionHint: Every save creates a new draft version and never edits an old one.

errors.AI_CONFIG_PROVIDER_INVALID: The provider does not exist or does not support text generation.

errors.AI_CONFIG_TRIAL_REQUIRED: Try this version with a sample question before publishing.
errors.AI_CONFIG_NOT_PUBLISHABLE: This version is already published or was revoked, so it cannot be published.
errors.AI_CONFIG_NO_PREVIOUS_VERSION: There is no previously published version to roll back to.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Invalid values. Temperature is 0 to 2, length is 1 to 32,000 and the prompt cannot be empty.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This version was not found. Reload the page.

trial.subtitle: Run a sample question over a sample source set with exactly the selected version's configuration. Sample sources are prewritten general knowledge, never learner documents.
trial.question: Sample question
trial.done: Version {{version}} answered via {{provider}}: {{input}} units in, {{output}} units out.

publish.confirmBody: Every new {{feature}} call will use version {{version}} right away. Version {{current}} becomes superseded and can still be restored.

rollback.unavailable: There is no previously published version.
rollback.confirmTitle: Roll back to the previous version?
rollback.confirmBody: Version {{current}} will be revoked and version {{previous}} republished right away for every new call.

diff.title: Compare two versions
diff.subtitle: Changed settings and the prompt line by line: added lines in green, removed lines in red.

policy.storageHint: At least 10 MB; 1024 MB is 1 GB.
policy.storageInvalid: Enter a whole number from 10 to 1,048,576.
policy.maxFileHint: From 1 to 2048 MB. Larger files are rejected as soon as a learner picks them.
policy.maxFileInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 2048, no larger than the storage per learner.

costs.title: Credit costs

confirm.policyBody: The new quota applies right away to every learner:
confirm.costsBody: New costs apply right away to tasks that start afterwards:

blocked.inputTitle: The assistant won't answer this question
blocked.inputReason: The question falls under {{category}}, so it was not sent to the assistant and used none of your credits.
blocked.outputReason: The answer contained {{category}}, so it was replaced with this notice.
blocked.suggestionsTitle: You could ask it another way:

VIOLENCE: Ask about the causes or consequences of violence, or how to prevent it.
For example: "What skills help resolve conflict without violence?"
HATE: Ask about the history, causes or harm of prejudice and discrimination.
For example: "How do stereotypes about immigrants form?"
SEXUAL: Ask about biology, reproductive health or how to stay safe.
For example: "What changes happen during puberty?"
HARMFUL_INSTRUCTIONS: Ask about the science, history or safety rules instead of how to make it.
For example: "Why are explosives so tightly regulated?"
FRAUD: Ask how to recognise and avoid scams, or what the law says.
For example: "What are the signs of a scam message?"
SELF_HARM: If things feel heavy, talk to someone you trust or call 115.

safety.flagged: Source {{list}} contained a sentence that looked like a prompt injection. It was ignored; the assistant only used the remaining content.

adminSafety.title: Content safety
adminSafety.subtitle: Every question and every piece of AI-generated content goes through the safety filter; text inside documents is always treated as data, never as instructions. The log records only the violation type and object ID, never the content.
adminSafety.loadFailed: Could not load the content safety settings.

levels.title: Filter levels
levels.subtitle: Levels apply to the very next call. The filter cannot be turned off; the most lenient level still blocks blatant requests.
levels.selfHarmNote: Always on: questions showing signs of self-harm get a caring reply with places to get help. Not adjustable.
levels.confirmBody: The new levels apply to every learner right away and are recorded in the audit log:
levels.defaultValues: Using the default levels set at installation.

trial.title: Try the filter
trial.subtitle: The question takes the same path as the study assistant: input filter, data wrapper, the published configuration and the output filter. Trial runs are logged as interventions too.
trial.question: Question
trial.sourceHint: Paste a passage to test injection protection, for example one containing "Ignore all previous instructions".

events.title: Recent interventions
events.subtitle: The latest 50. Only the violation type and object ID are kept.
events.empty: The filter has not intervened yet.
